    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionSender
    Concrete sender that builds lobby and game commands and pushes them to the server through the client's connection.
    AddStars
    Contextual effect that grants a fixed number of stars to the player when the owning card is acquired.
    Age
    Represents the ages (eras) the game progresses through.
    App
     
    Artist
    Represents an Artist card.
    AudioManager
    Manages background music and sound effects for the GUI.
    Board
    Represents the shared game board: the turn-order tile, the set of player tiles and the four card/building rows (top and bottom for cards and buildings).
    Builder
    Represents a Builder card, a specific type of card that provides discounts and prestige points.
    Building
    Represents a Building card, which has food cost and provides prestige points.
    Card
    Represents an abstract game card with its basic properties.
    Card.CardCategory
    Semantic categories a card can belong to, used for DTO serialization and client-side rendering.
    CardSet
    Contextual effect that grants food whenever the player completes a new card set.
    CavePaintings
    Event effect that rewards or penalizes each player based on how many Artist cards they own: players with fewer artists than the current age value pay prestige points, while the others gain prestige points scaled by their artist count.
    ChangeAgePhase
    CHANGE_AGE phase behavior.
    Character
    Represents a Character card, which extends the basic Card.
    CharacterEnum
    Identifies the six character types available in the game.
    CLIEnder
    End-of-game CLI screen: prints the final ranking (players by descending prestige) and offers to start another game or quit.
    ClientApp
     
    ClientLauncher
    Console entry point for the client.
    ClientManager
     
    ClientRMIInterface
    RMI callback interface implemented by clients to receive events.
    CLIinsputSender
     
    CLIinterface
     
    ConnectionProtocol
    Abstraction of a client-to-server connection, implemented by the socket and RMI client transports.
    ContextualEffect
     
    CountdownBannerController
    Controller for the countdown banner.
    CountdownDTO
    DTO sent to the single surviving player when the abandonment countdown starts.
    CreateGameCommand
    Client request that creates a new game lobby.
    Decks
    Holds the game's draw decks, keeping cards and buildings separated and partitioned by Age.
    DTO
     
    DTOQueue
    Single FIFO queue that decouples network I/O from UI rendering.
    DTOVisitor
    Visitor interface for polymorphic DTO dispatch.
    EndBuilderPpMultiplier
    End-game contextual effect that multiplies the player's accumulated builder prestige points by a fixed factor.
    EndCardSet
    End-game contextual effect that awards prestige points for each completed card set the player owns.
    EndGameController
     
    EndGamePhase
    END_GAME phase behavior (terminal state).
    EndOfTurnExtraPick
    Contextual effect that grants the player extra top-row picks at end of turn, applied when the owning card is acquired.
    EndTurnPhase
    END_TURN phase behavior.
    EnterLobbyCommand
    Client request that joins an existing lobby (or rejoins an active game).
    ErrorDTO
    DTO carrying a structured error for lobby/network operations.
    ErrorDTO.ErrorCode
    Error identifiers sent to clients.
    Event
    Represents an Event card.
    EventEffect
     
    ExecBottomBuilding
    Game command that picks a building from the bottom row.
    ExecBottomCard
    Game command that picks a card from the bottom row.
    ExecTile
    Game command that occupies a tile on the offer trail.
    ExecTopBuilding
    Game command that picks a building from the top row.
    ExecTopCard
    Game command that picks a card from the top row.
    Executor
    Base class of every in-game command.
    GainByCharacter
    Contextual effect that grants prestige points and/or food proportional to the number of cards of a given character type owned by the player.
    GameAnimator
    Owns all JavaFX transitions for the game screen.
    GameCommandSender
    Abstraction for sending game-phase actions from the GUI.
    GameConfig
    Holds game configuration values loaded from config.json.
    GameController
    Application controller for the game.
    GameDTOHandler
    DTOVisitor active during the game phase (after STARTING_GAME is received).
    GameEvent
    Represents a domain event emitted by the GameState when a significant action (valid or invalid) occurs, requiring notification to observers (e.g., View/Controller).
    GameEvent.Type
    Enumeration of the semantic types of events that can be broadcasted.
    GameEventDTO
    Serializable event payload sent to clients.
    GamePhaseBehavior
    Represents the behavior of a specific game phase within the State design pattern.
    GameSession
    An active game bundled with its dedicated single-threaded command queue and its transient abandonment-countdown state.
    GameSession.GameLiveness
    Transient per-game liveness (origin + active countdown) for the abandonment timer.
    GameState
    GameState: The root aggregate of the game model and the Context of the State Pattern.
    GameStateDTO
    Serializable snapshot of the public game state for network transport.
    GameStateDTO.BoardDTO
    Board data included in the public snapshot.
    GameStateDTO.PlayerDTO
    Player data included in the public snapshot.
    GameStateObserver
    A functional interface for observers that monitor the GameState.
    GameStatePersistence
    Centralized persistence service for saving and loading GameState snapshots.
    GameViewController
    Controller for GameScreen.fxml — a thin orchestrator over a single ObjectProperty<GameStateDTO> that drives the whole UI.
    Gatherer
    Represents a Gatherer card.
    GUIGameSender
    Translates GUI game-phase events into GameCommandSender calls.
    GUIInputSender
     
    GuiNodeFactory
    Stateless factory for the game screen's visual building blocks: image views, card/tile wrappers, rounded-corner clips, the selectable glow and resource-path resolution.
    HostResolutionException
    Domain runtime exception raised when no suitable local address can be resolved to advertise as java.rmi.server.hostname.
    Hunter
    Represents a specific type of Hunter character (Type 1).
    Hunting
    Event effect that grants each player food and prestige points proportional to the number of Hunter cards they own (prestige scaled by the current age value).
    IllegalMoveException
    Domain runtime exception used to report illegal moves.
    Inventor
    Represents an Inventor card, which is associated with a specific tool.
    InventorPair
    Contextual effect that grants food whenever the player forms a new pair of matching inventor tools.
    JacksonConfig
    Centralized Jackson configuration for save/load serialization.
    JavaFXApp
    JavaFX entry point.
    JsonFactory
    Loads game data (Characters, Events, Buildings, Tiles) from JSON resource files using Jackson polymorphic deserialization, and caches them for use by the game controller.
    LobbyAnimator
    Owns all JavaFX transitions for the lobby screen.
    LobbyCommandSender
    Abstraction for sending lobby actions from the GUI.
    LobbyController
    JavaFX controller for LobbyScreen.fxml.
    LobbyController.LobbyStep
     
    LobbyDTOHandler
    DTOVisitor active during the lobby phase (before the game starts).
    LobbyState
    Result of a lobby join request.
    LobbyUpdateDTO
    DTO carrying a lobby progress update: the current lobby state, the game id, an optional game-state snapshot (for rejoin) and the player counts.
    LocalHostResolver
    Resolves the IPv4 address to advertise as java.rmi.server.hostname so that remote peers can open callback connections back to this JVM.
    NUDEAnalyzer
    Parses raw client JSON into ServerCommand instances.
    NUDEanalyzerClient
    Parses raw server JSON on the client side into the matching DTO.
    NUDEGenerator
    Builds the JSON payloads for client-to-server commands, serializing each command through its ServerCommand action discriminator.
    NUDEPinger
    Background task that periodically pings all registered virtual views to detect client disconnections, driving heartbeat-based timeout handling.
    OpponentPanel
    Renders the opponents: the box ring anchored to the window's right edge and the collapsible per-opponent stats menu.
    OrderTile
    Represents a specific tile used for turn order.
    PendingGame
    Holds lobby state before a match starts, including join order and totem assignments.
    Player
    Represents a participant in the game: identified by a Totem colour and a nickname, owning food, prestige points, a hand of cards and a set of buildings, and tracking aggregate PlayerStats.
    PlayerBoxNode
    HBox node rendered for each opponent in the ring around the board.
    PlayerStats
    Aggregates the derived statistics of a Player: per-character counts, discounts, ritual modifiers, stars, builder prestige points, collected tools and various bonuses.
    PlayerTurnPhase
    PLAYER_TURN phase behavior.
    PopupFactory
    Builds the transient popups shown over the game screen: card detail, the per-character-type card list, and the hover-driven invention (tools) panel.
    ResponsiveLayout
    Installs the game screen's responsive behaviour: a uniform letterbox scale of the content over a reference resolution, the centred board wrapper, and the cover-style background that fills the window while preserving ratio.
    RMIclient
     
    RMIClientHandler
    Virtual view implementation that sends events to an RMI client callback.
    RMIServer
    RMI server entry point for lobby management and command execution.
    SaveObserver
    Observer that persists the game state to disk whenever a state-altering event occurs.
    SelectTotemCommand
    Client request that confirms a totem selection in a pending lobby.
    ServerCommand
    Root of every client-to-server message.
    ServerManager
    Coordinates lobby creation, player rejoin, and the lifecycle of active games.
    ServerRMIInterface
    RMI interface exposed by the server for lobby and command handling.
    SettingsMenuController
    Controller for the ESC settings menu.
    SettingsState
    In-session holder for user-tunable GUI settings.
    SetupPhase
    SETUP phase behavior, the entry state of the game.
    Shaman
    Represents a Shaman card, which has a certain number of stars.
    ShamanicLossProtection
    Contextual effect that reduces the penalty a player suffers when losing a shamanic ritual, by setting the player's ritual loss multiplier.
    ShamanicRitual
    Event effect comparing players' star counts: the player(s) with the most stars gain prestige points (scaled by their ritual win boost) and the player(s) with the fewest lose prestige points (scaled by their ritual loss multiplier).
    ShamanicWinBoost
    Contextual effect that increases the reward a player gains when winning a shamanic ritual, by setting the player's ritual win boost.
    SocketClient
     
    SocketClientHandler
    Virtual view implementation that serves a single socket client: reads incoming JSON commands in its own thread and writes serialized DTOs back to the client, also handling the ping/pong heartbeat.
    SocketDestroyer
    Background task that periodically prunes socket clients whose last pong is older than the timeout, disconnecting them through the ServerManager.
    SocketServer
    Socket transport entry point.
    socketTestServer
     
    StartTurnPhase
    START_TURN phase behavior.
    SustainmentBoost
    Contextual effect that grants the player a sustainment discount scaled by the number of cards of a given character type, applied on acquisition.
    Sustenance
    Event effect that makes every player pay food to sustain their characters.
    TestClientView
     
    Tile
    Represents a tile on the game board.
    TileId
    Identifies the board tiles, including the special turn-order tile and the lettered player tiles A through G.
    TileSet
    Represents a collection of game tiles.
    Tool
    The set of tools an Inventor card can be associated with.
    Totem
    The five totem colours that uniquely identify the players in a game.
    TotemLayerManager
    Owns the totem markers layered over the board: their image views, current tile destinations and the animated movement between snapshots.
    TotemPlacementBonus
    Contextual effect that grants the player extra food whenever they place a totem, applied on acquisition.
    TotemSelectionDTO
    DTO carrying totem selection status for a pending lobby.
    TriggerKey
    Enumerates all moments in which a building effect can be triggered.
    TurnPhase
    TURN phase behavior.
    UserInterface
    Contract implemented by every client-side view (CLI and GUI).
    VirtualView
    Base class for network-facing views that observe the game state and relay events to clients.
